content_sections.heading: CIMP Research Associate at a Glance

rows.details: CIMP Centre for CSR & ESG Studies Foundation
Research, Policy and Capacity Building Initiatives under the Centre for Urban Studies
Patna, with field travel across Bihar as required

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the essential qualification requirements specified in the notification to be eligible for consideration. Postgraduate in Social Work, Social Sciences, Public Policy, Urban Development, Architecture, Sustainability, Environmental Studies, or another relevant discipline with a minimum of 55% marks from a recognised university. Prior experience in research, WASH, sustainability, climate change, environmental governance, public policy, urban development or development sector projects. Proficiency in MS Office; strong research, analytical and report-writing skills; familiarity with qualitative and quantitative research methods. Basic Knowledge of SPSS/STATA, digital survey tools and experience in designing Training Needs Assessments (TNA) is desirable. Willingness to undertake field visits across Bihar. Working proficiency in English and Hindi is required.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration for the Research Associate position is determined as per institutional norms. The appointment is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project till 31st March 2027, with the possibility of an extension based on the continuation of project funding.

content_sections.heading: CIMP Research Associate Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected Research Associate will undertake the following key responsibilities: Literature review and background research. Design and testing of survey instruments and research tools, including development of survey modules for household, institutional and facility-level assessments. Primary and secondary data collection, management and analysis. Preparation of concept notes, technical reports, policy briefs and academic publications. Facilitation of Training Programmes and Support in Training Module Development. Coordination of field studies, stakeholder consultations, workshops and capacity-building programmes. Regular coordination with WaterAid India on survey module design, Training Needs Assessment (TNA), and other project deliverables and timelines. Liaison with government departments, development partners and community stakeholders. Project documentation, monitoring and dissemination of research outputs. Any other research and programme-related assignments as assigned by the Centre.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CIMP Research Associate
content_sections.text: Download or obtain the prescribed application form from official sources. Prepare an updated CV along with all necessary supporting documents and certificates. Send the filled prescribed application form, updated CV, and supporting documents via email to [email protected] . Ensure the application is submitted on or before 15 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on eligibility, relevance, and experience. Shortlisted candidates will be called for a personal interview. The selected candidate is expected to join immediately and must produce original testimonials at the time of joining.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. Candidates must have working proficiency in both English and Hindi. Willingness to undertake field visits across Bihar is mandatory. Original testimonials must be produced at the time of joining. For any queries, applicants can contact [email protected] .
